Maya: Opening thread for a compact 'Routing Guarantees' pilot proposal. Goal: ship a buyer-facing pledge with deterministic routing preference + documented cutover playbook. Scope: policy tags, dry-run router, residency telemetry, and a 6-step acceptance check. Minimal timeline: 8 weeks.
Omar: Sounds good. Minimal must-haves?
Maya: Policy tags on deployment API, router dry-run logs, per-tenant region histogram, SLA doc, and rollbacks. No dedicated hardware for pilot.
Claire: Security: must include KMS access logs and exportable audit CSV. Legal will likely require conservative residency language.
Omar: Perf caveat: namespacing KV cache reduces hit-rate in our sims by ~15%. For pilot we should soft-enforce routing and measure the delta.
Maya: Draft acceptance check (6 steps): 1) Create tenant with residency flag; 2) Deploy sample model; 3) Run synthetic traffic and confirm >=95% region-local routes; 4) Validate p95 <= 300ms; 5) Simulate zone drain -> fallback respects tolerance; 6) Export audit log CSV and KMS access proof.
InfraBot: Deploy scheduled: feature/routing-pledge -> staging 2025-07-14T14:00Z
Omar: Owners: Maya=product, Omar=router eng, Claire=security + legal touchpoint, SRE=canary/runbook (assign later). I'll prototype dry-run router week 1.
Maya: Action items: Maya create GH board + acceptance PDF; Omar implement dry-run and telemetry hooks; Claire draft KMS audit checklist; SRE prep rollback playbook. We'll check in next Wed. :thumbsup:
